title: Accounts Executive - Finance & Accounts
description:
**Company Name:** ***Aswatha TVS Two-Wheeler Showroom***  
**Department:** Accounts & Finance  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years (Preferred)  
**Location:** [Sungam coimbatore]  
**Salary:** As per industry standards and candidate experience

***Aswatha TVS*** Two-Wheeler Showroom is involved in the sales and service of TVS two-wheelers. We are looking for a responsible, detail-oriented, and organized Accounts Executive to manage day-to-day accounting operations and support the smooth financial functioning of our showroom.

***Job Summary***

The Accounts Executive will be responsible for maintaining daily financial transactions, vehicle sales accounting, customer payment records, bank reconciliation, and coordination with the sales, service, spare parts, and finance teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Maintain daily accounting entries for showroom sales, service, spare parts, receipts, and payments.
* Prepare and verify customer invoices, sales bills, receipts, and payment vouchers.
* Record two-wheeler sales transactions and ensure proper documentation for each vehicle sold.
* Maintain records of cash, UPI, card, bank transfers, and other customer payment modes.
* Reconcile daily cash collections with sales records and payment reports.
* Monitor customer advances, pending payments, refunds, and outstanding balances.
* Coordinate with banks and finance companies regarding vehicle loan disbursements and related payment settlements.
* Maintain accounts payable and receivable records and follow up on outstanding payments.
* Verify supplier invoices and process payments for spare parts, accessories, and other showroom expenses.
* Assist in GST invoice verification, GST reconciliation, and preparation of data for statutory filings.
* Handle TDS-related documentation and other applicable accounting compliance requirements.
* Perform bank reconciliation and maintain accurate financial records.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales and collection reports for management.
* Maintain proper documentation for vehicle stock-related financial transactions and coordinate with the inventory team.
* Support monthly closing, audits, and preparation of financial statements.
* Ensure all accounting records are accurate, up to date, and properly maintained.

Required Qualifications

* B.Com degree or equivalent qualification in accounting or finance.
* 1–3 years of experience in accounting; experience in an automobile dealership is preferred.
* Knowledge of Tally Prime or other accounting software.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel.
* Basic understanding of GST, TDS, bank reconciliation, and bookkeeping.
* Experience handling cash, bank transactions, invoices, and payment records.
* Strong numerical accuracy, organizational skills, and attention to detail.
* Good communication and coordination skills.

***Preferred Candidate Profile***

* Experience working in a two-wheeler or automobile showroom.
* Ability to manage daily sales accounts and cash reconciliation independently.
* Trustworthy, punctual, and committed to maintaining financial accuracy.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with sales, service, spare parts, and management teams.

***Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)***

* Accuracy of daily accounting entries and sales records.
* Timely completion of cash and bank reconciliation.
* Proper maintenance of customer and supplier accounts.
* Timely submission of financial reports.
* Accuracy of invoices and statutory documentation.
* Timely follow-up and tracking of outstanding payments.

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

title: Accountant (Finance & Accounts)
description:
Job Description: Finance & Accounts Executive

**Industry:** IT & Software  
**Department:** Finance & Accounts  
**Experience:** 2–3 Years  
**Job Location:** [Coimbatore]  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Finance & Accounts Executive to manage daily accounting activities, financial transactions, billing, bank reconciliation, and documentation. The candidate will ensure accurate financial records, timely reporting, and compliance with company accounting procedures.

Key Responsibilities

* Maintain daily accounting records, vouchers, invoices, and financial transactions.
* Handle accounts payable and accounts receivable.
* Prepare sales invoices, purchase entries, receipts, and payment vouchers.
* Perform daily cash handling, cash book maintenance, and bank reconciliation.
* Monitor customer outstanding payments and vendor dues.
* Maintain records of vehicle sales, purchases, expenses, and dealership transactions.
* Verify vehicle billing, customer payments, finance disbursements, and related documents.
* Coordinate with banks, financial institutions, vendors, and internal departments.
* Assist with GST entries, GST returns, TDS, and other statutory compliance activities.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly financial reports.
* Maintain petty cash, expense records, and employee reimbursement statements.
* Support monthly closing, ledger reconciliation, and audit requirements.
* Ensure proper filing and maintenance of financial documents.
* Follow company policies and accounting standards.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* B.Com, M.Com, or a related qualification in Finance and Accounts.
* 2–3 years of experience in accounting or finance operations.
* Experience in the automobile dealership industry is preferred.
* Working knowledge of Tally Prime, MS Excel, and accounting software.
* Basic knowledge of GST, TDS, and statutory compliance.
* Good understanding of bookkeeping, ledger maintenance, and bank reconciliation.
* Strong numerical, analytical, and organizational skills.
* Good communication skills and attention to detail.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Accuracy of accounting entries and financial records.
* Timely completion of bank and ledger reconciliations.
* Timely preparation of financial reports.
* Proper tracking of customer outstanding amounts and vendor payments.
* Accuracy of billing and documentation.
* Timely completion of statutory filings and accounting activities.

Salary and Benefits

* Salary: As per company norms and experience.
* Performance-based incentives, if applicable.
* Career growth opportunities.
* Other benefits as per company policy.

**Preferred Candidate:** A reliable and detail-oriented accounting professional with practical knowledge of Tally Prime, GST, bank reconciliation, and day-to-day financial operations.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹18,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: Pricing & CPQ - Analyst 2
description:
**Job Title \- Pricing \& CPQ \- Analyst \- ACS SONG**

**Management Level: Level 11 \- Analyst**

**Location: Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Ahmedabad**

**Must have skills: PROS Smart Price Optimization**

**Good to have skills: Pricing Tools**

**Experience: 2\-3 years of experience is required**

**Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)**

**Job Summary**


Results\-driven CPQ Pricing Analyst with 2–3 years of hands\-on experience implementing and optimizing CPQ solutions across mid\-size to enterprise organizations. Skilled in platforms such as PROS CPQ with a strong focus on pricing strategy, product configuration, discounting rules, and quote\-to\-cash automation. Adept at collaborating with cross\-functional teams—sales, finance, product, and IT—to gather business requirements, design scalable solutions, and deliver accurate, efficient quoting processes.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Provide functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools solutions like PriceFx, CONGA, PROS , SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus
* Build robust pricing models using advanced analytics and artificial intelligence to track key pricing KPIs, and build leadership dashboards in visualization tools.
* Work on assessing pricing processes in alignment with business imperatives and client’s sales strategy through client data diagnostics and gap analysis including current state assessment and future state design, Vendor assessment and selection.
* Work on designing and implementing pricing waterfall, pricing strategy, competitive pricing, pricing elasticity, margin analysis, pricing diagnostics, pricing catalog, and contract pricing of services, leading to a positive impact on topline and bottom line for global B2B organizations
* Work on B2B Pricing Analytics (Exploratory Analysis \& Reporting), target state analytics recommendation
* Work on recommending and deploying process improvements and enablers with best\-in\-class KPIs
* Work as an integral part of the client’s sales organization, towards driving efficient and effective structure pricing and discounting approach.
* You will work closely with our clients as Consulting Professionals who design, build, and implement strategies that can help enhance business performance within the Pricing \& CPQ area.
* The candidate will be responsible for providing functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools

  

**Professional and Technical Skills:**

* 2\-3 years of progressive industry and/or consulting experience in the Products/ Communications \& High Tech/ Financial Services industry/ Resources
* Experience working with PROS Smart Price Optimization \& Management (POM) \& Smart Configure Price Quote (CPQ). Certification in these areas is an advantage.
* Functional experience in Pricing of Services, products, parts, and post sales services
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Macro, and PowerPoint and exposure to Visualization Tools such as Power BI and Tableau
* Knowledge of other Pricing \& CPQ tools like PriceFx, CONGA, SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, PROS, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus are a plus

**Additional Information**

* Nice to have certification in any one of the following or equivalent from other pricing/CPQ solutions
* PROS Smart Price Optimization and Management  

PROS Smart Configure Price Quote

-------------

The role involves collaborating with business stakeholders, architects, technical teams, and sales teams to deliver scalable and best\-in\-class Finance Cloud solutions.


* Lead requirement gathering workshops, fit\-gap analysis, and solution design.

* Drive Finance processes across **R2R, P2P, O2C, and Asset Accounting**.
* Support data migration, testing (SIT/UAT), user training, and go\-live activities.
* Collaborate with integration and reporting teams for **OIC, REST APIs, OTBI, BI Publisher, and FRS**.
* Provide post\-production support and continuous process improvement recommendations.
**Your Profile**
----------------


* Strong experience in Oracle Fusion Financials implementations.
* Expertise in Finance business processes, accounting, compliance, and statutory reporting.
* Knowledge of SLA, financial reporting, data migration (FBDI/ADFDI), and integrations.
* Experience in stakeholder management, client engagement, and workshop facilitation.
* Oracle Fusion Financials Certification preferred.
* Exposure to global implementations and multi\-country rollouts.
* Understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials AI capabilities.

------------------------------------------


* We value flexibility and support a healthy work\-life balance through remote and hybrid work options.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Career development programs and certifications in cloud technologies.
* A diverse and inclusive workplace that fosters innovation and collaboration.
